project.name: content_writing
project.description: 从选题到成稿的内容创作管线

agents.name: Content Strategist
agents.role_goal: 根据给定主题，产出内容策略：目标读者、文章角度、关键要点。
acceptance_criteria: Must list at least 2 article angles
Must include acceptance criteria for the draft

agents.name: Writer
agents.role_goal: 根据内容策略撰写完整文章初稿。中文写作，有深度有案例。
acceptance_criteria: Must end with a call to action

agents.name: Editor
agents.role_goal: 审核文章初稿质量，修正问题，输出最终版本。
acceptance_criteria: Must state verdict: PASS or NEEDS REVISION
